attacks.name: The False Sovereign - Echo Skill 1
attacks.sourceText:
Transform into the False Sovereign and dash forward in a spinning strike, dealing 30.75% Electro DMG 4 times.
The Resonator with this Echo equipped in the main slot gains 12.00% Electro DMG Bonus and 12.00% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus. Upon casting Intro Skill, the False Sovereign is also summoned to deal 225.00% Electro DMG.
Start with 2 charges. Gain 1 charge every 8s, up to 2 charges.
